licenseeRegistrationEnabled.description: Whether this state's license data is live. When true, the state's licenses appear in public search and public provider detail, and the state is added to configuredStates with isLive false if it is not already listed. This does not grant privileges. Once true, it cannot be set to false. The name licenseeRegistrationEnabled is kept in the API and in DynamoDB for backwards compatibility.
